description: Weapon passives the export does not carry (the weapon's DefaultUpgrades; tools/import_weapon_passives.py). innate: export-shaped records, `effects` always on, `conditionalEffects` granted by the named replay event (noRefresh: CanReproc 0, not renewed while running); `fireModes` limits a record to those modes. superCritOnStatus: a pellet that applies a status arms the next pellet with probability `chance`; that pellet's crit chance is SET to `critChance`, replacing every other crit bonus. superStatusOnCrit: the same with a critical hit arming a SET status chance. excluded: every other DefaultUpgrade of an exported weapon and why it is left out. reloadProjectiles: the grenade a reload throws (Catabolyst), `empty` / `partial` by the magazine's state, contact and blast as separate hits.
